question: Jawara dance is a popular folk dance of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Jawara dance is a popular folk dance of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It is mainly performed in the Bundelkhand region of the state.
 
• The dance celebrates a good harvest, symbolizing joy and prosperity among the farming communities.
 
• Participants perform this dance with baskets full of crops, primarily jawara (barley), on their heads.
 
• The lively music and rhythmic movements express the happiness of the farmers after a successful harvest.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1794053179a00075131356025b5e331f22731b18858f6e45928e66afa190075.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kerala:**

 
 
• Kerala is known for classical dance forms like** Kathakali and Mohiniyattam** rather than folk dances like Jawara.
 
• The state's folk culture includes Kummattikali and Thiruvathira, but they are distinct from Jawara.
 
 
 
• **Himachal Pradesh:**
 
 
• Himachal Pradesh has folk dances like **Nati and Kullu Nati**, performed during festivals and cultural events.
 
• Jawara is not associated with this region.
 
 
 
• **Gujarat:**
 
 
• Gujarat is famous for its folk dances like **Garba and Dandiya**, which are performed during Navratri and other celebrations.
 
• Jawara dance is not part of Gujarat's folk traditions.
